subject: Re: CMMD kickoff — replacing FID in Evalline
body:
Wrap-up decisions.

1) CMMD went live in Evalline Apr 27, side-by-side with FID. The pre-briefing worked — the team affected by the #2/#3 flip re-ran their human-preference study and CMMD's ordering matched raters, which turned our loudest potential critic into the reference customer. Couldn't have scripted it better.

2) Decision: FID is deprecated for launch gates effective with the Q3 cycle; side-by-side reporting continues through end of Q3 for continuity, then FID becomes opt-in. Tomas is aligned.

3) Scope cut: video-generation support (frame-sampling scheme) was floated and is explicitly out — it needs its own design, punting to a Q3 proposal.

Chiara's docs + reference-set hosting are done. Nice tight project, thanks all.

Lucia
